finding: tests/test_review.py:425 The inert-Markdown test does not exercise a standalone bare URL.
rationale: The acceptance criterion explicitly requires inert bare HTTP(S) autolinks, but the fixture supplies URLs only as Markdown-link and HTML-image operands, so it can pass if those enclosing constructs are stripped while a prose-only URL still autolinks.

evidence.output: The statement fixture is `Acme [click](https://example.invalid/pixel)`, ``, and a forged heading; there is no standalone prose URL, and the assertions only reject the two enclosing constructs, the heading, and the raw URL substring.

AC6 says dataset-derived Markdown must be inert `including bare URL autolinks`; `_markdown_text` has a dedicated context-independent HTTP(S) colon-neutralization branch, but the test never drives that branch with a prose-only bare-URL input or asserts that its visible text survives.
